error[ZBX-E0563]: the Google credentials file is not one zbx supports
  cause  /home/ci/gcp.json can't be used: it holds gcloud user credentials
         (authorized_user)
  var    GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS
  type   authorized_user
  fix    use an external_account file with a credential_source file or HTTPS url
  more   zbx explain E0563
  docs   https://zigbox.github.io/zigbox/errors/E0563.html
